Atrium Team Stats (season, long form)

Source: R/atrium.R
atrium_team_stats.Rd

Team season statistics in long form (one row per team, table and statistic).

Endpoint: GET https://embed-api.eui.connect.sportradar.com/v1/embed/{website_id}/statistics_entities

Usage

atrium_team_stats(
  website_id,
  season = NULL,
  season_id = NULL,
  competition_id = NULL,
  locale = NULL
)

Arguments

website_id

(integer required): Site config id: which league site's widget this is (12 LNB France, 14 LNBP Mexico, 3 NBL1 Australia, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro). Not a league id: one site serves several competitions.

season

(integer optional): Season END year (2026 = 2025-26 on LNB, site 12, whose own year is the START year; the calendar year on the other sites). Needs competition_id when several competitions share that year (see atrium_seasons()). Omit season and season_id for the site's default season.

season_id

(character optional): Season UUID (season_id in atrium_seasons()); sent as is, skipping the END-year lookup of season.

competition_id

(character optional): Competition UUID (competition_id in atrium_seasons()). Picks the season together with season, and is then not sent; with neither season nor season_id the API filters by it.

locale

(character optional): Locale of the labels, e.g. "en-EN" or "fr-FR". Omitted = the site's own language. Ids and codes never change.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row per (table_key, entity_name, stat_key):

col_nametypedescription
website_idintegerSite config id the body came from (12 LNB, 14 LNBP, 3 NBL1, 13 El Salvador, 22 Panama, 236 Austria, 326 Montenegro), read from the body's links.self.
season_idcharacterSeason UUID of the table; null for the competition-scoped routes (their bodies carry none).
table_keycharacterStatistics table the row is from: averages, shootingstatistics, totals, ... (the set is per site).
table_labelcharacterThe table's heading in the site's language (e.g. Moyennes).
person_idcharacterPlayer UUID decoded from the widget link beside the name (the tables carry names only); null when the link is missing or undecodable, and always null in team and competition bodies.
person_namecharacterPlayer name as the site prints it; null in team tables.
entity_idcharacterTeam UUID decoded from the widget link (team tables only; player tables name the team but carry no id).
entity_namecharacterTeam name as the site prints it; for player rows of a stat table it is the player's team.
stat_keycharacterStatistic key as the API names it (pointsPerGame, fieldGoalsMade, ...), unchanged from header key.
stat_namecharacterShort column heading the site shows for the statistic (PTS, REB), in the site's language.
stat_labelcharacterLonger statistic label the site shows (code in the API), in the site's language.
valuedoubleNumeric value of the statistic; null when the API sends a duration or text (see value_text).
value_textcharacterNon-numeric statistic value, e.g. an ISO 8601 duration such as PT12M2S for minutes per game.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in atrium_fixtures().
